description.from:
Parked design spec only — do not implement from this epic. Do not post live. Ryan approval is required before any Slot is queued or any SharePayload is handed off.

## What Babulus is

Babulus is a **campaign factory**. AI agents and a human steer production of an entire campaign: landing page, video if any, image assets, social copy, PPC headlines/descriptions. Chattic.us is the bot farm that executes issues by type and state. Kanbus (Papyrus-style custom types, workflows, state names) is the tracker. VideoML is the renderer, not the calendar. Publicist governs what gets queued. Ryan approves.

## Inbound stays

Inbound marketing already exists (WaitlistSignup, MarketingLead, MarketingProgram/Step/Rule/Trigger, MarketingEnrollment, MarketingInteraction). Do not replace that. This epic is outbound owned media — a campaign factory, not a CRM rewrite.

## Buffer-style handoff (not auto-post)

Posting to LinkedIn / X / Google Ads / Meta is **optional** and may stay out of scope because those APIs are hard. **Do not auto-post.** Mimic Buffer: the system packs a complete payload (copy, media, link, channel, time). A human clicks once in a review UI; that click is what hits the target system (or opens the native composer already filled). **That click is the only write to the network.**

`queued` on a Slot means packed and waiting for the human click, not that a bot posted.

## Skip

- Media lists, journalist pitches, clip books
- Discord as a promo channel (Ryan already announces there; server is small)
- Papyrus/ANTH newsroom promote stage (editorial stops at published)
- Live ad-account writes
- Schema code, UI, auto-post, or any runtime from this epic

## Custom types (children of this epic)

| Type | Role |
| --- | --- |
| Campaign | Unit of work. Goal is a hire conversation. Checklist of deliverables. |
| Asset / deliverable kinds | LandingPage, Video, ImageSet, SocialCopy (linkedin\|x), PpcCopy |
| Creative | Blurb, script, or thumbnail attached to a Deliverable |
| Slot | When a packed item should go. Absorbs PromoSlot / Babulus-4c7. |
| SharePayload | Buffer analog: packed post or ad draft |
| VideoJob | Production of an Asset/Slot; VideoML renders; Babulus owns the job |
| CadencePolicy | Channel caps (config/rule, not a weekly-shipping type) |

## Campaign states

`planned` → `briefing` → `in_production` → `ready` → `live` → `closed`

Agents claim child work until the checklist is complete and on time.

## Slot states

`draft` → `ready` → `approved` → `queued` → `posted` \| `skipped`

Ryan must approve before queued.

## SharePayload states

`drafted` → `packed` → `awaiting_human` → `handed_off` \| `skipped`

`handed_off` = human clicked. No bot OAuth post required for v1.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  Campaign --> Deliverable
  Deliverable --> LandingPage
  Deliverable --> Video
  Deliverable --> ImageSet
  Deliverable --> SocialCopy
  Deliverable --> PpcCopy
  Deliverable --> Creative
  Video --> VideoJob
  VideoJob --> VideoML[VideoML renderer]
  Campaign --> Slot
  Slot --> SharePayload
  SharePayload --> HumanClick[Human click only write]
  Slot -.-> Lead[optional MarketingLead later]
```
description.to:
Parked design spec only — do not implement from this epic. Do not post live. **Publicist accepted this type list** (2026-09-01 campaign-ops research). Ryan approval is required before any Slot is queued or any Post/AdDraft is handed off.

## What Babulus is

Babulus is a **campaign factory**. AI agents and a human steer production of an entire campaign (landing page, video if any, image assets, social copy, PPC). Chattic.us is the bot farm. Kanbus (Papyrus-style custom types, workflows, state names) is the tracker. VideoML is the renderer, not the calendar. Publicist governs. Ryan approves.

## Namespace

This epic is **outbound owned-media**. Inbound Marketo objects stay (WaitlistSignup, MarketingLead, MarketingProgram / Smart Campaign / Step / Rule / Trigger, MarketingEnrollment, MarketingInteraction). **Do not collide** Babulus `Campaign` with Marketo Program / Smart Campaign.

## Buffer-style handoff (not auto-post)

Do not auto-post. The system packs. A human clicks once; that click is the only write to the network (or opens the native composer already filled). v1 `schedulingType` is always `human` / notification.

LinkedIn Posts API create is **PUBLISHED only** (no schedule field). `dueAt` lives on our Slot. Native LinkedIn clock can Schedule.

## Accepted issue types

| Type | Issue | Role |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Campaign | babs-477cc6 | Outbound owned-media unit of work. Not a Marketo Program. |
| Brief | (new) | Attached to Campaign; spawns Deliverables. Asana/Workfront intake. |
| Deliverable | babs-15b82c | `kind` enum only. One production workflow. |
| Creative | babs-947995 | Signed-off file/version that can be trafficked. Copy is not a Creative. |
| Idea | (new) | Optional, cheap. Buffer Idea: channel-less backlog. Promote → one Post per channel. |
| Post | babs-ab2033 | Buffer Post: packed copy+media+channel+time. Was SharePayload. |
| Slot | Babulus-4c7 | When. `queued` = packed awaiting Ryan click, not bot-posted. |
| AdDraft | (new) | PPC is not a Post. Pack Google/Meta **PAUSED**. Human click enables spend. |

## Not types (fields, states, or config)

- **CadencePolicy** — `postingSchedule` config on channel, not a work item
- **VideoJob** — render status on Deliverable `kind=Video`. Publicist should not see jobs
- **SharePayload** — name is gone; the type is Post
- **UTM, brand kit, LP SLA, legal** — fields/states, not types

## Deliverable kind enum (not five types)

`LandingPage` | `Video` | `ImageSet` | `SocialCopy` | `PpcCopy`

## Skip

- Discord as a promo channel
- Papyrus/ANTH promote stage (editorial stops at published)
- Journalist media lists, pitches, clip books
- Auto-post, schema code, UI, or any runtime from this epic

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  Campaign --> Brief
  Brief --> Deliverable
  Deliverable --> Creative
  Idea --> Post
  Deliverable --> Post
  Deliverable --> AdDraft
  Post --> Slot
  Slot --> RyanClick[Ryan click only write]
  AdDraft --> RyanClick
```
